notes.title: What's up, everyone! Got some news on the project!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Just wanted to give a quick heads-up on what's been going on here. I'm really excited to have started the next area of the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/6058587968307914cd0f7e3bf1eb26d43a9bad46.png"][/img][/p][p]On top of focusing on a completely new environment, I'm dedicated to adding some elements and mechanics that will be key to the puzzles coming up, making Kalia's journey even cooler and more interesting![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/2e145a8e3ed738e9ad2ddc07b29fb8403f8e8d28.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks a bunch for your support, and stay tuned for more good stuff![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers, Marcinho Manga.[/p]

notes.title: [Correction Patch] Climbing Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I want to extend my sincere thanks to the Dubhe community for helping me identify an issue.

Today, I would like to announce the implementation of a correction that resolves a bug in the climbing system.

With this correction, the climbing system now functions as intended.

Please keep sending your feedback and suggestions!

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Essential Fixes and Adjustments
notes.content:
Hello, Kalia explorers!

I'm happy to bring you a new update for Kalia. Every fix and adjustment is made with great care to improve your experience within the Ruin.

This small update focuses on crucial enhancements:

Fixed: Issues where pumps remained directly activated.

Adjusted: The floating platforms for better adaptation to challenges.

Thank you immensely for your patience and continued support as I build Kalia. Your feedback is invaluable!

notes.title: Kalia: Where Time Yields – New Area & New Ability!
notes.content: [p]Dear explorers and trailblazers of Kalia,[/p][p]Shaktini's journey within the Ruin is vast and full of mysteries, and we are thrilled to announce a significant new step in this adventure! Get ready for the latest content update: [b]Kalia: Where Time Yields![/b][/p][p]This update not only expands the confines of the Ruin but also grants Shaktini a power that will challenge the very perception of reality, deepening your immersion in her quest.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]✨ NEW AREA TO DISCOVER ✨[/b][/p][p]As Shaktini advances in her exploration, a new segment of the Ruin reveals itself. This majestic and treacherous new domain is an integral part of your main journey, a place that was guarded by temporal anomalies and ancient secrets. As you brave this area, you will encounter:[/p][list][*][p][b]Intricate New Environments:[/b] Traverse even deeper ruins, chambers pulsating with unusual energy, and landscapes where the flow of time behaves peculiarly. Every step in this new area deepens your understanding of the Ruin.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/c9eb236a9b4f97673479473bf73f14a109ec76b2.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Advanced Challenges:[/b] Puzzles and obstacles that will demand a new approach, testing not only your wit and agility, but also your adaptability to an environment where natural laws are tenuous.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/61166ce0fa56b8fd80039aa8771074ad3294ec5a.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Unprecedented Dangers:[/b] Meet new mechanisms and ancestral challenges that have protected this portion of the Ruin for eons, requiring renewed strategies to overcome.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]⏳ AN EPIC REWARD: The Time Manipulation Ability! ⏳[/b][/p][p]Only after unraveling all the secrets and overcoming the complex challenges of this new area will Shaktini make a transformative discovery. She will awaken a latent ability that will add an unprecedented strategic layer to your gameplay: [b]Time Manipulation![/b] With this power, Shaktini will be able to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Control the Flow Locally:[/b] It's now possible to slow down the speed of specific objects, turning imminent threats into opportunities. Think of deadly fast traps or platforms requiring impossible precision – all of this can now be controlled.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/ad932fe881a0d3250b60bf6900b5348f35a5db5a.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Unravel New Puzzle Solutions:[/b] Many of the enigmas of this new area, and even those in future areas, can only be overcome by using the time ability, allowing for dynamic interactions with the environment and the revelation of previously inaccessible passages.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reinvent Exploration and Overcoming Obstacles:[/b] Adapt to challenging encounters, manipulating time to your advantage, creating openings and planning your movements with mastery.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Your Journey Continues:[/b][/p][p]This update is another exciting step in Kalia's development, aiming to deepen the narrative, expand exploration, and introduce mechanics that will make Shaktini's experience even richer.[/p][p]Your feedback remains essential to us! Continue helping us shape the future of Kalia.[/p]

notes.title: Kalia - Phase 3 in the Home Stretch!
notes.content: [p]Hey there, Kalia adventurers! Marcinho Manga, your solo dev here.[/p][p]I have some super exciting news to share: [b]I'm in the final stage of Phase 3 of Kalia's development![/b] This means the next big update, packed with lots of new content and challenges, is almost ready to reach you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/67514f27f465b0a50b338d9d7b6c7eda0b92f3ee.png"][/img][/p][p]It's been intense days of work, fine-tuning every detail, implementing the last puzzles, and ensuring everything is perfect for your next journey through the ruins. My dedication is total to deliver something you'll love![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/dc4790107c5b653ee75f5fdd10b529169daef6d0.png"][/img][/p][p]Stay tuned! The update launch is right around the corner. I deeply appreciate everyone who follows the project and has already wishlisted Kalia. Your support is the fuel I need![/p][p]More details on what to expect will be coming soon. Cheers,[/p][p]Marcinho Manga[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/5d01565895de6a0c652332038bdf774a798d066a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/c356d9d3e9a7c181f85ef40ede9942a89a04921c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/43e6eba8d7e6aa7befa2f9032e9a8238eadb7e2e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Kalia: New Area Tease and Mechanics Tuned Up!
notes.content:
Hey there, Kalia adventurers! Marcinho Manga, solo dev here.

Just dropping by with news about our latest update! I've made some important tweaks to the game's mechanics to make the experience even smoother and more fun.

And for the biggest news: I've started building Kalia's next area! You can already catch a glimpse of it in the game, but hold your horses, it's not accessible yet. It's just a little tease of what's coming, to get you curious and excited! 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/8e9aa7c97f94cdf488992630a42555a0af0323fb.png[/img]

A huge thanks to everyone following Kalia and who's already wishlisted the game. Your support is what keeps me going!

Keep an eye out, because the adventure in Kalia is just starting to heat up!

Cheers,
Marcinho Manga

notes.title: Kalia Update: Implementing Puzzles for the Next Phase!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Marcinho Manga here, solo dev of Kalia. I'm pleased to share that Kalia is progressing to the next development phase, and I'm fully focused on creating and implementing the new puzzles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/06e6fb1634497929760feef8013bfc689105e530.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/18d1d2d13951b92b4cc25b1d623ec7a65429d580.png[/img]

This stage is crucial for the game, as I'm designing challenges that will test your reasoning skills and enrich the exploration experience. My goal is for each enigma to be engaging and rewarding for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/583ca6f3594c6dd312988872c1aff1055058d894.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/8e9aa7c97f94cdf488992630a42555a0af0323fb.png[/img]

I deeply appreciate everyone who has already wishlisted Kalia. Your support is a huge encouragement for me as a solo dev.

Keep following for future updates. Kalia's development is moving steadily forward!

Sincerely,
Marcinho Manga

notes.title: Kalia's Next Steps: What's Coming!
notes.content:
In future updates, you can look forward to seeing:

New areas to explore: The world of Maha Yuga Stambha will continue to expand, revealing unseen ruins and ancient secrets. Prepare your platforming skills for new challenges!

Puzzles that will make you think: I'm creating even more intriguing and environment-integrated puzzles that will require logical reasoning and keen observation to solve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/d805c9dd7fdc7b566ada23a61b79db9dafe2e8e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/54019f8d11fee325d8d55388eef56730abde0b9e.png[/img]

Deepening of the story: Kalia's narrative will gradually unfold, with new clues about the lost civilization and the mysteries surrounding it. Get ready to unravel the truth behind the devastation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/b89add7c085deafe1f4eab20104d6ebb244cbc41.png[/img]


Refinements and improvements: I will continue to polish the game mechanics, interface, and performance, based on the valuable feedback you've been sharing. The gameplay experience will become increasingly fluid and immersive.
This is just a taste of what's coming to Kalia! Stay tuned to the next dev blogs for more details, images, and exclusive development videos. Your participation and enthusiasm are the driving force behind this project.

Kalia's journey continues, and I'm so happy to have you all on board!
